fact: Bank of Mauritius Governor Thakoor says the bank's infrastructure includes the Mauritius Central Automated Switch (MauCAS), whose QR payments are now usable in Mauritius and India.
Bank of Mauritius Governor Thakoor says the bank serves as settlement bank for COMESA's REPSS.
The Bank of Mauritius's July 2026 guideline says it issues payment service provider licences under the National Payment Systems Act and that payment aggregators must hold one.
The Bank of Mauritius granted a Payment Service Provider licence to EZ Dash Limited on 28 August 2024 under the National Payment Systems Act 2018.
